lines.en: Seems like a trap...
lines.zh: 看上去是个陷阱……
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Better keep your eyes open, then, and blink us out if things go sideways.  We need the book...
lines.zh: 那就保持警惕，如果情况有变，就把我们传送出去。 我们需要那本书……

lines.en: ...  By the heavens...
lines.zh: …… 苍天啊……
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Isn't that...  that crazy mage who gave us such trouble before?!
lines.zh: 那不是…… 那个之前给我们制造了大麻烦的疯子法师吗？！
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Yes...  And apparently, one of the Nephilim...
lines.zh: 是的…… 而且很显然，也是圣灵之一……

lines.en: ...Am I dead?
lines.zh: ……我死了吗？
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: Just about.  But you'll be fine.
lines.zh: 差一点。 但你会没事的。

lines.en: Splendid...  looks like those imperial goons couldn't get the best of me, after all.  I do suppose I owe you a thank you, mmm?
lines.zh: 好极了…… 看来那群帝国蠢蛋最后还是没搞定我。 我想我欠你一句谢谢？
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: How about an apology?  You know, for stealing our property.
lines.zh: 不考虑道歉吗？ 你知道，因为你偷了我们的财产。

lines.en: Oh, that belonged to you?  Goodness, had I known I was dealing with such lovely specimens, I would've just asked nicely instead.  Name's Beatrix Pendergast.
lines.zh: 哦，那是你们的？ 我的天，早知道我是在和如此可爱的人儿们打交道，我就会客客气气地向你们借了。 我是碧翠丝·潘德加斯特。
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: ...Pendergast?  As in, Edmund Pendergast?
lines.zh: ……潘德加斯特？ 就是，埃德蒙·潘德加斯特的那个？

lines.en: That's the one, darling.  Edmund's little princess.
lines.zh: 就是那个潘德加斯特，亲爱的。 埃德蒙的小公主。
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: Interesting. I wonder what someone from such a family would be doing out here?
lines.zh: 有趣。出身如此高贵的人在这里做什么？

lines.en: Beatrix...  you must come with us.  You are one of the ancient Avatars of Donar, reborn into our world.
lines.zh: 碧翠丝…… 你必须和我们一起走。 你是多纳尔的古老化身之一，重生到了我们的世界。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Wait just a minute...  how did you...
lines.zh: 等一下…… 你是怎么……
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en:
Ah ha!  Of course, you pulled me from the brink.  Signature move of Donar himself.  Well, well, fancy meeting you here, a thousand years later.
And you, the gigantic paladin. Inheritor of Galzus's legacy, no doubt.  Eat any good books lately?
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: Beatrix, the Nephilim are destined to reunite and fight Zanatus in the final battle.  It is written in the prophecy, which has thus far come true.
lines.zh: 碧翠丝，圣灵注定要重聚并与扎纳图斯决战。 预言记载如此，目前还未有偏差。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Yes, that is the "prophecy" as they say, isn't it.
lines.zh: 是啊，这就是人们所说的那个“预言”，不是吗。
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: If you don't like prophecies, take a look, all but one Nephilim Avatar is standing in this room.  We have much to discuss - let's head back to Embor.
lines.zh: 如果你不喜欢预言，看看周围吧，圣灵化身现在只差一个，其他的都在这儿了。 我们有很多要讨论的事情——先回恩博尔吧。

lines.en: Oh, really?  And just why should Beatrix Pendergast comply with the likes of you, hmm?
lines.zh: 哦，真的吗？ 为什么碧翠丝·潘德加斯特要听从你这样的人呢？
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: I have an army, and you owe me one.
lines.zh: 我有一支军队，而且你欠我的。

lines.en: You know... I always did love it in Embor.  What with the year-round, bone-chilling winter, the endless, featureless fields... the bland, lard-based cuisine...  yes, what a lovely destination.  After you!
lines.zh: 你知道……我一直都很喜欢恩博尔： 终年寒冷刺骨的冬日，一望无际、平淡无奇的田野……清淡的猪油料理…… 是啊，真是一个不错的目的地。 您先请！
lines.name: 贝雅特丽
